executiveSummary: Active exploitation of NetScaler ADC/Gateway unauthenticated RCE presents immediate initial-access risk to many CI operators; patch to fixed builds, assess for compromise, and consider temporarily disabling DTLS on VPN vServers. Security Advisory F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth Authorization Server heap overflow (RCE) is under active exploitation; apply hotfixes/iRules, restrict OAuth endpoints, and investigate for anomalous OAuth failures and crashes. Security Advisory U.S. agencies warn of active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs via S7comm and open-source tooling; remove Internet exposure, enforce protection levels, and monitor TCP/102. Security Advisory Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager zero-day (CVE-2026-76504) is confirmed exploited and listed in KEV; remove Internet exposure and upgrade immediately. Security Advisory CISA weekly bulletins highlight critical OT/adjacent flaws, including Advantech EKI industrial gateways enabling unauthenticated RCE and insecure management functions; prioritize isolation and firmware updates. Supporting Report Armatura One embeds vulnerable ActiveMQ OpenWire (CVE-2023-46604) by default; upgrade to vendor-fixed versions and restrict broker exposure. Vendor Advisory Additional KEV additions affecting enterprise perimeters (FortiMail path traversal; Apple OOB write) increase IT-to-OT pivot risk; patch and validate no pre-patch compromise. Security Advisory Mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) by ShinyHunters (incl. FBI jobs portal) underscores WAF-bypass risk on HR/recruiting systems; patch and normalize encodings in WAF. View Article

items: Action: Patch, disable DTLS until updated, assess for compromise.
Apply hotfix and iRule; restrict OAuth endpoints; investigate TMM cores.
CVE-2026-76504: Active exploitation; remove Internet exposure and upgrade.
Unauth RCE, insecure mgmt (TCP/5058), OPC UA DoS; patch and segment.
FortiMail path traversal; Apple OOB write - patch, validate no pre-patch compromise.

descriptions: Exploit public-facing applications (ATT&CK T1190): NetScaler ADC/Gateway, F5 APM, SD-WAN Manager, PeopleSoft.
External remote services (T1133) and Valid Accounts (T1078): VPN/Gateway abuse; AiTM session hijacking (TA419).
Adversary-in-the-middle (T1557) for MFA bypass: Reverse proxy cookie theft against M365.
Modify cloud/edge configurations (T1098.003/T1556): SD-WAN/ADC admin plane abuse; API manipulation.
Domain Policy Modification (T1484.001): Ransomware leveraging domain-root GPOs to disable protections and deploy payloads.
ICS Protocol Abuse: S7comm memory read/write, OPC UA session exhaustion (DoS).

outlook72h: Day 0-1: Emergency patch windows for NetScaler ADC/Gateway, F5 APM, Cisco SD-WAN Manager. Disable DTLS on unpatched NetScaler VPN vServers; remove Internet exposure of SD-WAN Manager; apply F5 iRule/hotfix. Day 0-2: Validate Siemens S7 exposure; block TCP/102 at perimeters; enforce PLC protection levels; baseline S7comm and create alerts for write operations. Day 1-2: Update Advantech EKI/WISE gateways; restrict management interfaces; deploy monitoring for TCP/5058 and OPC UA session spikes. Day 1-3: Review edge device logs for indicators (web shells, abnormal OAuth/API usage); rotate tokens/creds; perform targeted threat hunting in management networks. Day 2-3: Patch Oracle PeopleSoft; update WAF normalization rules; review export/job histories and SSO sessions for anomalies.
